run_image_pair_visualization: run the CLI main function to visualize point correspondences between two images using a SuperPoint model
create_point_correspondences: create point correspondences between two images by running SuperPoint detection and nearest-neighbor matching
create_img_pair_visual: create a side-by-side image pair visualization with matched keypoints drawn as colored circles and connecting lines
visualize_img_pair: visualize an image pair with matched keypoints and draw correspondence lines between matching points
save_image_pair: save a visualization image pair to a specified output directory with a custom filename
